about.description: Shows technical information about the bot

embed.description:
Music, temporary voice rooms, free game alerts, welcome messages and more, each feature turned on by the admins with **/setup**.

If you want to read or contribute to my source code, it is available in this [GitHub]({repository}) repository

Use **/help** to find out what I can do!
embed.author: Author

help.title: Hello, @{user}!
help.intro: Here are the commands you can use in **{server}**. Click one or type **/** to start.

setup.description: Turns the bot's features on and off and configures them in this server
setup.noPermission: Oops! you need the **Manage Server** permission for that..

hub.title: ⚙️ Đoge Bot setup
hub.description: Pick a feature in the menu to turn it on, off or configure it.
hub.introDescription:
Music and interactions already work. Pick any other feature in the menu to choose its channels and turn it on.

You can come back to this panel at any time with **/setup**.

language.title: Language
language.description: Let's get **{server}** ready, one step at a time. First, pick the language I speak in this server: it applies to everything I post and to my replies.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.intro: Without the right permissions I can't post, clean channels or create rooms, so let's check what my role can do here.
permissions.ok: ✅ I have every permission I need.
permissions.fix: To fix it, open **Server Settings → Roles → Đoge Bot** and turn those permissions on, or give me **Administrator**. If a channel still blocks me, add my role in its **Edit Channel → Permissions**. Then click **Check again**.
permissions.channelHint: Add my role in the channel's **Edit Channel → Permissions**.

notices.onIncomplete: Turned on: pick what is missing for it to start working

music.name: Music
music.description: A player with a queue in the voice channel: /play, /queue, /skip and friends. Messages show up where the command was used, or in the chosen channel.

fun.name: Interactions
fun.description: /pet, /kiss, /slap and /ship. Replies show up where the command was used, or in the chosen channel, and whoever gets the kiss, the slap or the ship is notified.

welcome.name: Welcome and logs
welcome.description: Announces who joins and leaves and logs nickname and avatar changes.

rooms.name: Temporary rooms
rooms.description: With /room each member creates a private voice room, which disappears when it empties.

gameAlerts.name: Game alerts
gameAlerts.description: Free games (Epic, Steam...) as soon as they show up and, every Friday at 18:00 (Brasília), the week's Steam deals, filtered so they don't turn into spam. Prices and offers follow the region picked. Members pick the mentioned role in Channels & Roles, in Discord itself.

onboarding.title: 👋 Hello, {server}!
onboarding.description:
I'm **Đoge Bot**: music, temporary voice rooms, free game alerts, welcome messages and more.

Click **Configure** (or use **/setup**) and I'll guide you: first the language, then my permissions, then the features. Except for music and interactions, all start off until an admin configures them.

By using me you agree to the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy below.
onboarding.noChannel:
I joined **{server}** but I can't write in any of its channels, so I'm reaching out here.

Give my role **View Channels**, **Send Messages** and **Embed Links** (or **Administrator**) in **Server Settings → Roles → Đoge Bot**, then use **/setup** in the server: I'll guide you through the language, my permissions and the features.

By using me you agree to the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy below.
onboarding.footer: Only those who can manage the server can configure it
